evidence.reason: The current implementation still requires a prose delimiter before a later scheme hit unless it is the first URL. For a path-nested URL such as `https://web.archive.org/web/2020/https://u:p@host/`, the outer path slash clears `inAuthority`, but the preceding `/` is not in the delimiter set, so the nested hit is dropped. `redactUrlUserinfo` then only examines the outer authority, which ends at the first `/`, and finds no `@`, leaving `u:p` visible. This is an implementation defect in the documented free-text redaction behavior, not a new hardening request.
